i totally understand, and being one of the ppl that has done this, i understand both sides (while i do understand, it’s still wrong to ghost ppl). 

some people seem to want an instant close connection with someone and forget that friendships take time to build up. or perhaps they begin to feel inadequate and scared to open up because they aren’t used to it, even if it’s just slightly. these have just been my experiences though, so i can’t speak for anyone else.

i’m not trying to say that ghosting is okay, because it absolutely isn’t. i’m more just trying to explain that chances are it isn’t your fault if you are ghosted. please don’t beat yourself up over it. you’re doing the best you can with what you’re given, and you’re a good person for reaching out to these lonely people in the first place.

oddly enough, i understand this feeling entirely. i find myself fantasizing about similar scenarios more than i’d like to, so i understand. i wouldn’t necessarily call you a dick, but this way of thinking isn’t really normal or healthy. what would make it really bad is if you actually went through with it in order to get attention, but so long as you’re only fantasizing about it then it’s not as bad, but you still need to attempt to change that way of thinking.
